You can get a ramdisk with busybox from <a href="/download/ramdisk/ramdisk.gz">here</a>. Just copy it to <i>arch/mips/ramdisk/ramdisk.gz</i> from the root directory of your kernel source.
<br>Or, if you prefer to build your own take a look at this <a href="http://www.linux4.be/~jroark/howto/ramdisk.html">tutorial</a>.
